profile.headline: Software Engineer | Javascript | Typescript | React | GraphQL | Python
profile.summary:
I am seeking a full-stack position. I value a culture that invests in its engineers through an environment of collaboration while also encouraging autonomy. I’m looking for an environment that provides opportunities to grow and develop as an engineer.

I am a Software Engineer with a strong foundation in full-stack development. I am proficient in leveraging technologies with their best practices to create robust and efficient software solutions. I hold an Advanced Software Development Certificate from Hack Reactor and possess expertise in front-end and back-end technologies. I am eager to apply my expertise and passion for software development to drive innovation and success in a dynamic software engineering role.

If you think I would be a good fit for your team, please reach out over LinkedIn and I would be happy to chat with you.

positions.title: Front End Web Developer
positions.description:
Develop wiki-fandom page for TRPG: Legends of Auzu

Designed theme and color scheme based on game photos utilizing wiki-fandom Theme Designer
Built reusable and flexible web based page templates using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
Communicated with client while also making independent development and design decisions

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and developed an application that consolidates anime voice actor information based on users' watch history.
Utilized GraphQL, Apollo Client, and AniList API to generate lists based on user input of either show title, voice actor name, or character name
Designed interlocking links for faster and more flexible access of information between pages
Created PostgreSQL database to store information based on the users watch history

positions.title: Full Stack Web Developer
positions.description:
Recruitment software with AI-powered search and match capabilities

Developed a Recent Activity menu utilizing TypeScript, React and Python to reduce candidate search time
Engineered five front-end GraphQL based filter features to save 20 hours of manual data processing per week
Expanded on and authored internal debugging architecture to reduce time spent troubleshooting 
Developed resume highlighting technology with React-PDF and CSS that increased user engagement by 30%
Collaborated remotely and asynchronously with cross-functional teams to design and engineer features utilizing Figma, Slack, Trello, and pair programming

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and implemented a full-stack mockup of a business e-commerce product page, featuring user reviews and Q&A components.
Developed modal components using the ReactJS framework to streamline and validate user-generated data.
Optimized runtime speed for PostgreSQL pagination queries from 543 msec to 49 msec, leading to 20% faster processing

positions.title: Program Manager and Engineer
positions.description:
Engineered a real-time multiplayer gaming interface leveraging Socket.io 
Managed a team of 8 engineers and delivered the project on time to lead a live walk-through presentation
